claim: For an alias to another record in the same hosted zone, all record types are supported except NS and SOA. At the zone apex, an alias record can't route traffic to a record whose type is CNAME.

qualifiers.scope: alias to another record in the same hosted zone
qualifiers.condition: at the zone apex, not to a CNAME record

evidence.quote: Select the type of the record that you're creating the alias for. All types are supported except **NS** and **SOA**.
If you're creating an alias record that has the same name as the hosted zone (known as the *zone apex*), you can't route traffic to a record for which the value of **Type** is **CNAME**.
